name: figure
description: An inline SVG (sanitized; paths marked data-k-draw draw on when it appears) or an image, with a caption.

svg.description: an <svg>…</svg> string; use currentColor or var(--pl-*) for colours

src.description: data: URI, or a path relative to the spec file

example.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 40'><path data-k-draw d='M4 36 C 40 36, 60 30, 96 4' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='3'/></svg>
example.caption: Growth curve
